items.quote: And the LORD went his way, as soon as he had left communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.
items.claim: The text says that after the LORD finished speaking with Abraham, the LORD left and Abraham went back to his own place.
items.action: ended the conversation and left; Abraham went back to his place
items.place: Abraham's place (the text doesn't name it)
items.mechanism: The conversation ended, so both parties went their separate ways.
